rubric_items.reason: Built on existing DoctorService, daySlots, localDay/addDays/dayBounds, AppointmentRepo and DoctorDetailPage. It follows the HMS-7 detail-field precedent and adds no new infrastructure.
S-1 to S-4 are each mapped to components and endpoints. REQ-1 to REQ-10 are traced in Known, including the PAST-as-neither rule, Not available, ?date= and Inactive null.

Every nextSevenDays field has a type, nullability, format and example. However, the NextDay type has no stated home, and the PATCH/POST responses (built by get()) silently gain the field while EP-3 lists no field changes.
Nearly every choice is cited or decided by A-06/A-07, and types.ts lines are cited directly. But C15 cites impact C14, which does not state the ignore-in-PATCH precedent.
Trade-offs are given for the shared rule refactor, the single week query and the picker not writing back to the URL.
Clear and consistent. One small traceability slip in the C15 citation.
